question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"usage."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** 'usage'** refers to the act of using something. (किसी वस्‍तु का प्रयोग (प्रयुक्त होने का ढंग); प्रयुक्त हुई वस्‍तु की मात्रा) • **Example**: *The earliest recorded **usage__** of the word is in the twelfth century.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The sentence is likely to discuss the amount of usage of a particular item or resource. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: The average weather in a location over several years is __referred__ to as the climate. Climate change is characterised by a __shift__ in those average circumstances. The fast climate change we are presently witnessing is the result of humans' __**usage**__ of oil, gas, and coal in their homes, industry, and transportation. When these fossil fuels are ______ (4) ______, they emit greenhouse gases, mostly carbon dioxide (CO2). These gases capture the Sun's heat, raising the planet's ______ (5) ______.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (spill)** means to accidentally pour something out of its container. ((तरल पदार्थ का) पात्र से एकाएक बाहर निकल आना, छलकना; तरल पदार्थ को छलकाना) • **Option 2 (purchase)** means to buy something. (ख़रीदना, क्रय करना) • **Option 4 (wastage)** refers to the act of wasting or using something in a careless or inefficient manner. (किसी वस्‍तु की बरबादी; बरबाद हुई वस्‍तु की मात्रा) 9a:T1052, The correct answer is **"burned."**
